title: Groupe Onepoint is a EUR 500m dual Camunda and Flowable partner listed without a website
content:
Groupe Onepoint is recorded at over EUR 500m turnover, operating from Paris and seven further cities, dual-certified with Camunda Silver alongside its Flowable listing. It is the largest French presence in the Flowable sweep and, at that turnover, an enterprise-scale sale.

The dual position is the substantive part. Camunda and Flowable are the same architectural gap twice: both orchestrate when things happen while holding the process or case instance as mutable state with purgeable history, so neither owns the append-only, user-attributed record of what was decided. A partner certified on both can reuse one integration across two platforms, which improves the economics of the first build for whoever does it.

The row also carries a data-quality flag — no website link on the Flowable card. Forty2's card in the same sweep has the identical omission, so this looks like patchy directory data rather than anything about the firms; either way the domain needs confirming before outreach. Provenance: Flowable Partner Finder (flowable.com/company/partners), mined 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
